ielts_exam_challenge.title: IELTS Academic Task 2: Remote Work vs Traditional Office Culture
ielts_exam_challenge.context_prompt: Technological advancements allow an increasing number of employees to telecommute from home. Discuss whether telecommuting benefits the economy or weakens corporate cohesion.
ielts_exam_challenge.passage: The rapid expansion of the telecommuting flexibility benefit has transformed modern white-collar employment. Advocates point out that eliminating daily transit times elevates work-life balance equilibrium and enhances employee retention. Conversely, organizational analysts warn that prolonged telecommuting can erode workplace peer camaraderie, foster occupational burnout syndrome through blurred domestic boundaries, and hinder mentorship programs essential for career progression.

questions.label: Which positive benefit of remote work is cited in the passage?
options: Elevates work-life balance equilibrium and employee retention
questions.answer: Elevates work-life balance equilibrium and employee retention
questions.explanation: The text states that working from home elevates work-life balance and aids worker retention.

questions.label: What hazard of working from home does the text highlight?

questions.explanation: The passage warns that blurred boundaries can foster occupational burnout and erode camaraderie.
